requirements.text: Real-time transaction notifications that include contextual information for transparency.
Instant card control features for freezing and unfreezing cards easily.
A unified view of all financial accounts on a single home screen.
In-app support features like AI-assisted chat for streamlined customer service.
Biometric authentication for enhanced security and convenience during login.
In-app lending and credit applications for streamlined processes related to overdrafts and personal loans.
Accessibility compliance to ensure the app is user-friendly for customers with visual impairments.
New features must seamlessly interact with the existing API layer of the core banking system without significant modifications.
Real-time notifications should be processed within five seconds of a transaction.
All sensitive customer data must be encrypted and comply with the latest security standards.
Must adhere to Central Bank regulations and PSD2 requirements for strong customer authentication.
Maintain backward compatibility with the existing app for at least six months during the transition.
